moves.label: Quick Nose-Hair Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a tiny close-range poke and short active timing.
moves.reason: Compact standing punch silhouette.

moves.label: Low Plank Bonk
moves.description: Slow low swing that drags a plank-like strike through the shins.
moves.reason: Low forward board swing reads as a grounded low.

moves.label: Hajike Head Rush
moves.description: Fast mid rush with a long active scramble of cartoon body pressure.
moves.reason: Long active sequence of Bobobo lunging and flailing forward.

moves.label: Nose-Hair Sweep Rush
moves.description: Fast mid rush that whips forward with extended green nose-hair arcs.
moves.reason: Green rope-like arcs match Bobobo's nose-hair fighting style.

moves.label: Twin Hajike Dive
moves.description: Slow mid jumping assault that dives forward into a spinning impact.
moves.reason: The sequence visibly jumps and dives through mid-height frames.

moves.label: Plank Pop Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher that pops forward from a goofy plank windup.
moves.reason: Board-starting animation is already authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Low Plank Fakeout
moves.description: Steady low feint that threatens a plank swing before resetting.
moves.reason: Low command uses the plank-start sequence with low-hit data.

moves.label: Flying Nose-Hair Trip
moves.description: Steady low knockdown that flips Bobobo into a sliding tumble.
moves.reason: The move transitions into an airborne fall and floor-level finish.

moves.label: Hajike Power Bonk
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown that commits to a heavy gag-style body blow.
moves.reason: Heavy forward posture and authored knockdown fit a power crush.

moves.label: Crouch Nose-Hair Wheel
moves.description: Fast mid crouch attack that rolls nose-hair arcs across the body.
moves.reason: Full-crouch row shows spinning circular nose-hair effects.

moves.label: Crouch Hajike Launcher
moves.description: Fast mid launcher that bursts up from crouch with wild arm pressure.
moves.reason: Crouch route is authored as launcher and rises through open-hand frames.

moves.label: Charged Nose Jab
moves.description: Quick high charged jab with a simple close poke.
moves.reason: Charge command reuses compact high jab frames.

moves.label: Hajike Sun Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown that launches a giant sun-faced rush forward.
moves.reason: Large sun-face visual and charge command justify the special name.

moves.label: Sidestep Plank Low
moves.description: Steady low sidestep strike that swings the plank from an angle.
moves.reason: Sidestep command uses the low plank-swing animation.

moves.label: Motorcycle Rising Strike
moves.description: Fast mid while-standing rush that rides through with a motorcycle hit.
moves.reason: The row clearly swaps into a motorcycle-riding strike sequence.

moves.label: Low-Step Nose Jab
moves.description: Quick high poke from a low command that still checks head height.
moves.reason: Contact frames match the compact high jab.

moves.label: Down Plank Trip
moves.description: Steady low plank strike that clips the legs from a crouched route.
moves.reason: Low command and plank swing sit around shin height.

moves.label: Forward Hajike Launcher
moves.description: Fast mid launcher that surges forward with long active pressure.
moves.reason: Long active rushing sequence is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Diagonal Plank Low
moves.description: Steady low diagonal strike that swings the plank through the legs.
moves.reason: d/f low uses the same low plank contact sequence.

moves.label: Forward Nose-Hair Wheel
moves.description: Fast mid advancing strike that spins nose-hair loops in front of Bobobo.
moves.reason: Forward route shows circular nose-hair arcs during contact.

moves.label: Forward Plank Low
moves.description: Steady low forward strike with a committed plank swing.
moves.reason: Forward low route uses the plank-swing frames.

moves.label: Hajike Dash Jab
moves.description: Quick high motion jab with compact active timing.
moves.reason: qcf route reuses the high jab silhouette.

moves.label: Hajike Plank Low
moves.description: Steady low motion strike that sweeps the plank forward.
moves.reason: qcf low route uses the plank contact sequence.

moves.label: Bo-bobo World Burst
moves.description: Fast mid jumping knockdown that dives forward in a surreal cape-like rush.
moves.reason: The finisher has a large transformed diving visual and authored jump knockdown.
